results.title: [PDF] Thesis - UvA-DARE (Digital Academic Repository)
results.content: In Chapter 4, we examined how mistrust toward important social referents at school (teachers and peers) was associated with the interpersonal relationships that early adolescents form with specific others. Several findings support this conclusion: (1) social mistrust toward peers was associated with peer-trust behavior during an online task, whereas mistrust toward teachers and general mistrust was not; (2) differences in mistrust between countries varied depending on the referent; (3) cross-cultural differences in referent-specific mistrust were explained to varying degrees by early adolescents’ individual cultural values; (4) developmental trajectories of mistrust differed depending on the referent; and (5) the associations between mistrust and interpersonal relationships over time also varied by referent.
